name: og
description: Per-URL Open Graph / Twitter meta for link previews: the SPA shell's <head> is rewritten for crawlers by the server (Node and Cloudflare Pages alike)

env.description: Public origin of the site (https://app.example.com) used in og:url / canonical / og:image. Set it on every deployed instance: empty = those tags are left out (the request host is never believed)

Service token the UI SERVER reads the API with for link previews of record pages (server/utils/server-api.ts). Create it in the API without roles (read-only): npm run auth:token -- create --name og-preview --days 365. Empty = record pages get the generic preview

next: set NUXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL on every deployed instance — without it link previews carry no og:url / canonical / site-relative image

next.text: link previews + sign-in: a crawler cannot pass single sign-on — it is redirected to the login page and never sees a preview unless the proxy lets crawler requests for page URLs through without a session; and the API answers 401 to it, so the UI server reads records with its own read-only service token ({{kit.uiDir}}: API_SERVICE_TOKEN; create it with `npm run auth:token -- create --name og-preview --days 365` in the API). See "Link previews" in .memory/docs/guides/usage.md
